{{Short description|English-born Canadian biologist}}
'''Michael Locke''' (February 14, 1929 in [[Nottingham]], U.K – October 20, 2013 in [[London, Ontario]]) was an English-born Canadian biologist.  He was Chair of Zoology at [[Western University (Canada)|Western University]] from 1971 to 1985 and a [[Fellow]] of the [[Royal Society of Canada]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Remembering Michael Locke (1929-2013)|work=Department of Biology|date=4 November 2013|publisher=Western University|url=http://www.uwo.ca/biology/news_and_events/2013/remembering_michael_locke.html|accessdate=15 April 2016}}</ref>
